parameter_semantics: No high-level parameters. Phase is inferred only from two causal observations, oldest first. The framework may duplicate the initial episode frame; no future state, contact truth, action history, or hidden phase variable is supplied.
output_semantics: Each slot is [world-frame TCP position xyz in metres, world-frame TCP rotation as first two rotation-matrix columns (6D), native gripper scalar]. Decode projects 6D rotation by safe Gram-Schmidt and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured qpos. The action is intentionally world absolute to retain demonstrated world/reachability structure while the causal input exposes phase. Prediction slots are t-1 through t+14 and execution uses slots 1 through 8; gripper >=0 opens and <0 closes.

conversion_check.description: Compare FK of decoded joints with the demonstrated commanded world TCP pose in metres/radians and compare the gripper scalar. Valid 6D labels round-trip; degenerate sampled rotations are deterministically projected. IK diagnostics are explicit.

cut_relation: All twelve assigned [740,1270) segments are unchanged. This preserves every action in the 210-action incoming and 150-action outgoing overlaps while refining causal observations for lid-release, approach, closure, and lift phase discrimination.
